servicesStatus: Describe your garment and care label. Confirm which care options are currently available and suitable before arranging a service.
pricingStatus: Request a garment-specific quotation. Confirm the available service and price with the team before paying.
turnaroundStatus: Confirm the cleaning service, suitability and estimated completion date directly. Cleaning timing depends on the garment, treatment and current capacity.
arrangementsStatus: For standalone garment care, confirm any pickup or delivery arrangements and charges directly. The standard suit package separately includes initial door-to-door Kigali delivery; outside-Kigali courier or agency charges are customer-paid and confirmed before dispatch.
